name: Select fields
summary: The simplest query: a few fields from the selected object, limited to 100 rows.

name: Select all standard fields
summary: FIELDS(STANDARD) expands to every standard field. Use FIELDS(ALL) or FIELDS(CUSTOM) with a LIMIT of 200 or less.

name: Record by Id
summary: Look up a single record. Paste the 15 or 18 character Id into the quotes.

name: Count rows
summary: COUNT() with no other fields returns just the number of matching rows.

name: Recently modified
summary: The most recently changed records, newest first.

name: Name starts with
summary: LIKE is case insensitive. % matches any run of characters, _ matches one character.

name: Value in a list
summary: IN matches any of the listed values. Also works with a semi-join sub-query, see Relationships.

name: Empty and not empty
summary: SOQL uses = NULL and != NULL rather than IS NULL.
soql: WHERE Name != NULL AND Description = NULL

name: Grouped AND / OR
summary: Use parentheses whenever AND and OR are mixed, SOQL has no implicit precedence you want to rely on.

name: Multi-select picklist
summary: INCLUDES and EXCLUDES are the only operators for multi-select picklists. 'a;b' means both a and b are selected.
soql: WHERE MultiPicklist__c INCLUDES ('Value A', 'Value B;Value C')

name: My records (USING SCOPE)
summary: USING SCOPE restricts rows to a predefined set such as Mine, Team, Delegated, Everything, or My_Territory.

name: Parent fields (lookup)
summary: Walk up a lookup with dot notation, up to five levels. Custom relationships use __r.
soql: SELECT Id, Name, Account.Name, Account.Owner.Name, CreatedBy.Name

name: Child records (sub-query)
summary: A nested SELECT on the child relationship name returns the related children with each parent row.
soql: (SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName)

name: Parents that have children (semi-join)
summary: IN (SELECT ...) keeps only parents with at least one matching child. The sub-query must select a single Id field.
soql: WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true)

name: Parents without children (anti-join)
summary: NOT IN (SELECT ...) keeps only parents with no matching child.
soql: WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact)

name: Polymorphic field (TYPEOF)
summary: Select different fields depending on the concrete type behind a polymorphic lookup such as Task.Who or Event.What.

name: Count by field
summary: Every non-aggregated field in SELECT must appear in GROUP BY. The count column is returned as expr0 unless aliased.
soql: SELECT StageName, COUNT(Id) Records, SUM(Amount) Total

name: Find duplicates (HAVING)
summary: HAVING filters groups after they're built, so it can use aggregate functions where WHERE can't.

name: Min, max and average
summary: Aggregates without GROUP BY return a single row.

name: Subtotals (ROLLUP)
summary: ROLLUP adds subtotal rows for each grouping level plus a grand total. GROUPING(field) is 1 on the subtotal rows.
soql: SELECT StageName, Type, COUNT(Id) Records, GROUPING(StageName) IsStageTotal, GROUPING(Type) IsTypeTotal

name: Created this week / month / year
summary: Date literals like THIS_WEEK, LAST_MONTH and THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER are evaluated in the user's time zone.

name: Last N days
summary: LAST_N_DAYS:n runs from midnight n days ago through to the end of today. NEXT_N_DAYS, LAST_N_WEEKS, LAST_N_MONTHS and friends work the same way.

name: Between two dates
summary: Date literals are YYYY-MM-DD, date/time literals are YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ (UTC) with no quotes.

name: Group by month
summary: Date functions such as CALENDAR_MONTH and FISCAL_QUARTER can group and order rows. Wrap the field in CONVERTTIMEZONE to use the user's time zone instead of UTC.
soql: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(CreatedDate) Yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(CreatedDate) Mth, COUNT(Id) Records

name: Sort by two fields, nulls last
summary: The default sort is ascending with nulls first. NULLS LAST pushes empty values to the end.
soql: ORDER BY Industry ASC NULLS LAST, AnnualRevenue DESC

name: Page with LIMIT and OFFSET
summary: OFFSET skips rows and is capped at 2,000. For deeper paging, order by Id and filter WHERE Id > the last Id seen.

name: Page by Id (beyond 2,000 rows)
summary: Keyset paging: run again with the last Id from the previous page to get the next page. No OFFSET limit.

name: Recycle bin (deleted records)
summary: IsDeleted rows are only returned by queryAll, so run this with the Query All command (Shift-Cmd-R) rather than Query.

name: Field history
summary: Every object with field history tracking has a History object. For custom objects it's MyObject__History.
soql: SELECT ParentId, Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate

name: Active users
summary: Users with their profile and role names.
soql: SELECT Id, Name, Username, Email, Profile.Name, UserRole.Name, LastLoginDate

name: Record types for an object
summary: Record types are rows in the RecordType object, filter by SobjectType.

name: Apex classes and triggers
summary: Setup metadata is queryable too. ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ApexPage and Flow all live in the Tooling and Enterprise APIs.
soql: SELECT Id, Name, ApiVersion, Status, LengthWithoutComments, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate

name: Login history
summary: Who logged in, from where, and whether it worked.
soql: SELECT UserId, LoginTime, LoginType, SourceIp, Status, Application, Browser

name: Find across all objects
summary: SOSL searches text indexes across many objects at once. Terms support * and ? wildcards, and AND, OR, AND NOT.
soql: RETURNING Account(Id, Name), Contact(Id, Name, Email), Lead(Id, Name, Company)

name: Find in name fields with a filter
summary: Each RETURNING object can have its own WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT.
soql: RETURNING Contact(Id, Name, Account.Name WHERE Account.Industry = 'Technology' ORDER BY Name LIMIT 50)

name: Find by email or phone
summary: EMAIL FIELDS and PHONE FIELDS restrict the search to those field types, which is much faster than ALL FIELDS.
soql: RETURNING Contact(Id, Name, Email), Lead(Id, Name, Email), User(Id, Name, Email)
